title: Rabbi Chanan of Tzippori
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bereshit Rabbah 10:4 Rabbi Pinchas speaks in his name. There, at 13:9, he speaks in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani; in Kohelet Rabbah 1:7, Rabbi Chanin of Tzippori in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani, and some say the reverse. In the work cited as ב״ק, chapter 15, section 2: “Rabbi Chanin of Tzippori said: The Holy One, blessed be He, enlightened Rabbi Yose’s eyes,” etc. He is also mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2.

notes.text: The supplied ב״ק chapter 15 section 2 is retained literally. The named comparison at Bereshit Rabbah 15:2 is separately disclosed, rather than silently rewriting the source abbreviation.
The corresponding saying is in the consulted Bereshit Rabbah 15:2, which names Chanin of Tzippori. The supplied abbreviation remains ב״ק.
